channel.description: Latest articles from Pajhwok Afghan News (pajhwok.com)

item.title: United Kingdom pledges £3m in aid to Afghanistan
item.description: The United Kingdom Special Representative for Afghanistan, Richard Lindsay, says his country is providing an additional £3 million (AFN 257 million) in aid to Afghanistan.

item.title: Gold prices in Kabul fall amid rising dollar, global market pressure
item.description: Gold prices have declined in the capital, Kabul, in recent days, with jewellers attributing the drop to falling global prices, while experts point to an appreciation of the US dollar, increased gold sales and a shift in investment towards oil and gas as key factors.

item.title: Process for transferring passport information for Afghans living in Saudi Arabia to begin
item.description: KABUL (Pajhwok): The Afghan Embassy in Saudi Arabia has announced that the process of transferring passport information for Afghans living in the country will begin

item.title: Beijing opposes violations of other countries’ sovereignty, says China FM
item.description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi said Beijing would maintain an “objective and fair position” and oppose violations of other countries’ sovereignty.

item.title: Bennett calls for transparent probe into Pakistani strike on Kabul drug rehab centre
item.description: UN Special Rapporteur on the situation of human rights in Afghanistan Richard Bennett has called for an independent and transparent investigation into a Pakistani military regime airstrike on a drug rehabilitation hospital in the capital Kabul.

item.title: 3-day Afghan products exhibition to open in Tashkent
item.description: A three-day Afghan products exhibition titled “Made in Afghanistan” is all set to open in Tashkent, the capital of Uzbekistan, today (Wednesday), the Afghanistan Chamber of Commerce and Investment (ACCI) said.

item.title: Afghan MMA fighter Nazhand to face Argentine opponent in May
item.description: Afghan mixed martial arts (MMA) fighter Wahidullah Nazhand is scheduled to compete with his opponent from Argentina Laureano Staropoli on May 9, the Fight Nights Championship (FNC) announced on Wednesday.

item.title: 2 civilians martyred in Pakistani artillery strikes on Kunar
item.description: At least two civilians have been martyred and eight others wounded after Pakistani military regime fired 85 artillery shells into eastern Kunar province, an official said on Wednesday.

item.title: Grassroots football festival held in Kabul
item.description: A grassroots football festival was held in the capital Kabul today (Wednesday) with the participation of 200 athletes, the General Directorate of Physical Education and Sports said.

item.title: 21 killed, over 600 wounded in Balkh, Herat accidents during Eid
item.description: At least 21 people were killed and more than 600 others injured in separate traffic accidents during Eid-ul-Fitr holidays in northern Balkh and western Herat provinces.

item.title: Over 200 injured in Israel in past 24 hours amid Iran-Lebanon attacks
item.description: More than 200 people were injured in Israel over the past 24 hours amid ongoing attacks by Iran and Lebanon’s Hezbollah on the country, a media report said on Wednesday.

item.title: Abdul Karim Badakhshi to face Spanish opponent on March 28
item.description: Afghan mixed martial arts (MMA) fighter Abdul Karim Badakhshi will face his Spanish opponent Fabia Sintes on March 28.

item.title: 17 artefacts discovered in Baghlan: MoIC
item.description: The Ministry of Information and Culture (MoIC) says 17 artefacts, including stone tools and pottery fragments, have been discovered in northern Baghlan province.
